These font files are subsets (latin) of:

- Fraunces (variable, opsz 9-144, wght 100-900)
  Copyright 2020 The Fraunces Project Authors (https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces)
- Atkinson Hyperlegible (regular and bold)
  Copyright 2020 Braille Institute of America, Inc. (https://www.brailleinstitute.org/freefont)

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1, available with a FAQ at
https://openfontlicense.org
